description: List the price data points your workspace has contributed to the shared data exchange, newest first: each one's vertical, source, product, price, currency, quality score, status and the tokens it earned. Filter by status or vertical and page with limit and offset. Free to call. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

status.description: Only contributions with this status, for example validated.

name: list_jale_contributions
